Added `capitalize(str)` to `src/str.js:7` and a test in `test/str.test.js:12`. Both tests pass.

Two notes on the implementation:
- It uppercases the first UTF-16 code unit. For astral characters (e.g. emoji, some scripts) `s[0]` splits a surrogate pair. If that matters, `[...s]` or `String.prototype.at` with code-point handling would be safer — I kept it simple to match the existing style of `trim`.
- It doesn't lowercase the rest, so `capitalize('aBC')` → `'ABC'`. That's the common "capitalize first letter" semantic, but if you want title-case behavior, say so and I'll change it.

No commits made.
